Specification: This specification models a PlusCal algorithm that mutually recursively computes whether a number is even or odd using two procedures, Even and Odd, with an explicit call stack introduced by the PlusCal translation. The translated TLA+ system tracks control flow in pc, local procedure parameters xEven and xOdd, the global result variable, and a stack of activation records represented as records in a sequence. The specification initializes a call to Even(2), allows normal execution plus infinite stuttering after reaching termination, and verifies termination with the temporal property <>(pc = "Done"); it also imposes weak fairness on Next.
IfThenElse: IF xEven = 0 THEN /\ result' = TRUE /\ pc' = "e1" /\ UNCHANGED << stack, xOdd >> ELSE /\ /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Odd", pc        |->  "e1", xOdd      |->  xOdd ] >> \o stack /\ xOdd' = xEven - 1 /\ pc' = "Odd1" /\ UNCHANGED result

IF xOdd = 0 THEN /\ result' = FALSE /\ pc' = "o1" /\ UNCHANGED << stack, xEven >> ELSE /\ /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Even", pc        |->  "o1", xEven     |->  xEven ] >> \o stack /\ xEven' = xOdd - 1 /\ pc' = "Even1" /\ UNCHANGED result
